title: Recently Deleted
description: Recover deleted notes, knowledge resources and clipboard items
desktopRequired: Manage recently deleted items in the Friday desktop app.
emptyHint: Deleted resources are kept here. Sensitive clipboard content cannot be recovered after expiration.
confirmPermanent: Permanently delete these {count} items? This cannot be undone.
missingNotebook: The original notebook no longer exists. Restore to All Notes? You can also cancel and export a copy.
loadFailed: Could not read Recently Deleted. Refresh to retry. Your records remain on this computer.
operationFailed: The operation did not finish. Refresh and retry, or restore from a backup.
exportFailed: Export did not finish. Check directory access and file name conflicts, then retry.

errors.TRASH_PARENT_MISSING: The original location no longer exists. Restore elsewhere or export a copy.
errors.TRASH_DESTINATION_EXISTS: A resource with the same name already exists. Choose another location or export a copy.
errors.TRASH_NOTEBOOK_MISSING: The original notebook no longer exists. Confirm a new restore location.
errors.TRASH_SOURCE_MISSING: The source no longer exists or sensitive content has expired. Check local backups.
errors.TRASH_EXPIRED: Sensitive content has expired and cannot be restored.
errors.TRASH_NOT_FOUND: This record has already been processed. Refresh the list.
errors.TRASH_PATH_INVALID: Invalid restore location. Choose another location.
